competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a sharp blade and inflicts continuous damage for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Performs a ruthless charge, attacking all enemies 3 times. Each attack has a 35% chance to inflict Continuous Damage for 1 turn and the skill will deal 50% increased damage to enemies under harmful effects.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
Increases damage per debuff on the target
effets.note: increased damage to enemies under harmful effects

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times. Each hit decreases their Defense for 2 turns and blocks them from removing harmful effects for 2 turns. Afterwards, decreases their Attack Bar by 30% in proportion to the number of harmful effects granted on them.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

Harmful effects cannot be removed while this effect is on. This effect will be removed first when a harmful effect removal skill is used, and other harmful effects can be removed afterwards. Does not apply to bosses.
